summary: The executor fallback behavior and regression coverage largely match the saved plan: provider no-work failures classified from stderr persist structured recovery metadata, create fallback or same-provider retry workspaces with lineage and preserved policy/profile/validation fields, reset fallback retry counters, keep deterministic non-provider no-work failures terminal, and the planned focused tests plus ruff/mypy pass. However, the implementation does not fully achieve the saved plan because stale executor TODO comments still describe provider fallback dispatch as future work.
gaps: Remove or replace the stale provider fallback TODO comments in src/awf/control/executor.py that still say AGENT_PROVIDER_CAPACITY_EXHAUSTED fallback dispatch is future work, especially around the agent-run salvage path and no-work failure path now covered by executable provider recovery assertions.
